Looking at the code, I can see the issue. The `gate` command in the frai CLI is defined with variadic arguments `[args...]`, but the action handler only captures the positional arguments in the `args` parameter. With Commander.js, when you use `.allowUnknownOption(true)`, unknown options may not be automatically included in the variadic args array.

The fix is to use `process.argv` directly to capture all arguments after the `gate` command, ensuring flags are preserved:

name: Responsible AI Gate
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  rai-gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      # Blocks the build until every Responsible AI Gate check in the spec is answered.
      - run: npx frai-gate check FRAI-SPEC.md
